sources.title: Batch 0047 source-first inventory for top-quartile purchase-ranking SQL

claims.text: The source asks for users ranked in the top 25% by purchase volume and explicitly names PERCENT_RANK() or NTILE(4), but does not preserve a concrete schema or whether purchase volume means count, quantity or money; the candidate therefore states SUM(quantity) and its table shape as a minimal executable contract.

The executable fixture verifies that detail purchase records are first aggregated to user grain, then PERCENT_RANK is computed in descending purchase quantity and the <=0.25 threshold selects the leading users.

The fixture verifies top-value ties, multiple records per user and the single-user boundary; the candidate explicitly distinguishes percentile-rank semantics from NTILE(4) row-bucket semantics and does not promise an exact 25% headcount when ties or small populations are present.
